answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the ledge solution is checked at the marble gate and logged, the cedar audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The fee repeats 14 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
